description: This Java source file contains abstract test cases for verifying the registration of command classes within the Eclipse Ditto project. It uses JUnit for testing and class indexing to ensure commands are properly annotated and registered, focusing on command parsing and module completeness.

classes.name: GlobalCommandRegistryTestCases
classes.description: Abstract base class for testing command registration and classpath completeness in the Eclipse Ditto service.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the list of JSON parsable commands by scanning annotated classes.

methods.name: isExcluded
methods.description: Determines if a class should be excluded from testing based on its simple name.

methods.name: sampleCheckForCommandFromEachModule
methods.description: JUnit test that verifies all command classes in the classpath are included in the sample list.

methods.name: ensureSamplesAreComplete
methods.description: JUnit test that verifies that all packages containing command classes are represented in the samples.

methods.name: getPackagesDistinct
methods.description: Helper method to extract distinct packages from a collection of classes.

methods.name: allCommandsRegistered
methods.description: JUnit test confirming that all command subclasses are annotated with @JsonParsableCommand.

methods.name: allRegisteredCommandsContainAMethodToParseFromJson
methods.description: JUnit test ensuring each JSON parsable command class has a method to parse from JSON.

methods.name: assertAnnotationIsValid
methods.description: Validates that a command class has the correct parse method as specified in its annotation.
